scope: Static local source audit of category representativeness, SVG semantics and renderer fallbacks. No external location contents, gameplay availability, missions, collectibles, spawns, vehicle control or coordinate accuracy were verified.

sourceSnapshot.note: Root announced a dist → public migration during this audit; findings apply to these cached input hashes, not any subsequently edited source.

colorPolicy.action: Preserve effective group and special-use colors. Change shape or presentation category only when evidence supports it; do not arbitrarily recolor icons.
colorPolicy.note: The initial per-category tuple colors are overwritten by the loop at the end of map-types.js. Effective colors, not initial declarations, are the actual runtime semantics.

categoryAudit.assessment: A location pin is an honest generic fallback, but many explicitly named facilities remain here and disappear from their specific category filters.

recommendation.action: Reclassify only explicit supported record titles using the recordIssues list. Retain map-pin for genuinely generic locations.

Multiple buildings distinguish general housing from the single-house safehouse glyph.

sampleRecords.name: City of Vice Fire Rescue Station

recommendation.action: Reclassify named prison buildings/towers, police departments and fire stations using their existing specific categories; keep unspecified civic records here.

categoryAudit.assessment: Generic public building suits diverse civic facilities without inventing an interactive service.
Shield/check is distinct from prison bars/fence, emergency vehicles and government buildings.
Building with cross clearly denotes a medical facility.
Vertical fence bars distinguish incarceration from police; current jail-tagged records are representatively classified.
Shield with three dots means generic security, not aviation. Add a plane/shield or runway/shield glyph.

recommendation.action: Replace shield-ellipsis with a plane/shield glyph.

categoryAudit.assessment: Factory glyph represents the industrial records; separately classified office buildings have briefcases.
Business briefcase is a conventional office symbol.
Lightning bolt represents power, but the records include water and communications infrastructure. Keep the generic category and use supported record subtype glyphs where possible.

recommendation.action: Retain broad utility category/color; optionally use antenna for explicit radio/cell/broadcast tower titles and water for explicit water infrastructure. Review Footbridge L1726 for Transport.

categoryAudit.assessment: Hard hat clearly represents construction, without asserting mission access.
Route glyph fits generic bridges, ramps and other transport infrastructure.
Plane with runway/takeoff baseline distinguishes an airport from an aircraft item.
Anchor is suitable for a marina or boating facility.
Front-facing rail vehicle and rails communicate rail transport.
Compact rail-vehicle front distinguishes metro facilities from other transport categories.
The SVG shows a gondola suspended from a sloping cable, not a guideway train. Use an elevated people-mover glyph.

recommendation.action: Replace suspended cable-car with an elevated guideway train glyph.

categoryAudit.assessment: Front-facing bus is clear and distinct from the train/metro glyphs.
Shopping bag is a correct general retail fallback, but explicit service/store names should receive their existing specialist categories.

recommendation.action: Apply supported specialist title/dossier mappings, especially Rideout Customs L2375; leave ambiguous retail generic.

categoryAudit.assessment: Uses the same crosshair as Weapon pickups. Current colors differ, but the primary glyph cannot distinguish purchase locations from loose pickups. Use a gun-store/storefront-target glyph.

recommendation.action: Use a storefront plus target; keep crosshair for loose Weapon pickups.

categoryAudit.assessment: Pump and nozzle accurately represent fuel facilities.
Wrench matches modification services and their current records.
Adjustment controls are a broad service metaphor; no current records.

categoryAudit.assessment: Paint bucket suits paint service, but Watkins Auto Parts is not self-evidently a respray business; the source tag must remain qualified.

recommendation.action: Keep paint-bucket for the category. Review L348 Watkins Auto Parts if its #pay'n'spray tag refers to an actual paint service; do not infer service availability from the icon.

categoryAudit.assessment: A front-loading laundry machine collides exactly with Laundromats. Use a car with water droplets.

recommendation.action: Replace laundry-machine glyph with car/water droplets; retain washing-machine exclusively for laundry.

categoryAudit.assessment: The only record is Motorcycle Customs Shop?; the bicycle rider glyph and Bicycle label overinterpret an ambiguous #bikeshop source tag.

recommendation.action: Do not equate ambiguous bike with bicycle. Review L1608 and present the explicitly titled Motorcycle Customs Shop? under Vehicle customization/Vehicle services while retaining its uncertainty.

categoryAudit.assessment: Shirt fits clothing retail; shared Apparel shape is understandable because both are clothing, though a store badge could improve distinction later.
Medical syringe suggests an injection instead of a tattoo machine. Replace with a stylized tattoo pen or machine, retaining service color.

recommendation.action: Replace medical syringe with tattoo pen/needle symbol.

categoryAudit.assessment: Scissors conventionally represent hair services.
Monitor is a conventional electronics retail symbol.
Cart is appropriate, but several records are gas-station shops and one is a souvenir shop; preserve their supermarket evidence while exposing secondary facility tags.

recommendation.action: Retain supermarket-tagged shop classification and support secondary fuel-station discovery for seven gas-station titles; review L3079 souvenir-shop conflict.

categoryAudit.assessment: Pill clearly denotes pharmacy supplies.
Wine glass is an appropriate alcohol-retail metaphor.
Footprints communicate footwear at small size.
Awning storefront fits a vendor stall.
Money badge indicates trade; keep distinct from physical fence/prison glyphs and retain source uncertainty.

Music notes and this label do not represent broad leisure-tagged records such as lifeguard towers, sports fields and tennis courts. Use a neutral Leisure venues display label and reclassify explicit specialist names.

recommendation.action: Broaden display label and glyph for the source leisure bucket; move explicit tennis, race, bar and cinema titles to their existing categories. Preserve canonical key until all filter translations are updated.

categoryAudit.assessment: Fork/knife directly represents dining; a fastfood-tagged entry is a narrower classification opportunity.
Burger silhouette clearly indicates fast food.
Cocktail glass is suitable for bars.
Record/disc is a conventional dance-music venue metaphor.
Sparkles are a deliberately abstract nightlife symbol; category label provides the specific meaning.
Sandwich distinguishes street food from drink stalls.
Lidded cup/straw is a clear drinks symbol.
Tree is an acceptable broad nature umbrella; no current records.
Tree pair represents woodland, while many of the 99 records are oceans, rivers, lakes, hills and sandbars. Use a general landscape glyph with water/land or record subtype overrides.

recommendation.action: Use a balanced landscape symbol; optional water override only for names/tags that explicitly identify water features.

categoryAudit.assessment: Wheat is appropriate for agriculture and Sugar Fields, but Sunrise RV Park conflicts with a farm interpretation of its unconfirmed source tag.

recommendation.action: Keep wheat for agriculture. Review Sunrise RV Park L265; a neutral Recreation presentation avoids claiming it is a farm based solely on an unconfirmed agriculture tag.

categoryAudit.assessment: Tent/tree fits outdoor recreation; do not imply camping availability without evidence.
Racket/net stringing is sport-specific and clearly different from golf/volleyball.
Triangular pin flag is a recognizable golf-hole metaphor.
Plain flag is shared with Street races. Use a track-loop glyph for the venue, keeping a checkered flag for race activities.

recommendation.action: Differentiate track venues from Street races with a closed-circuit glyph.

categoryAudit.assessment: Dumbbell directly conveys exercise.
Volleyball seam pattern represents the sport.
Clapperboard is a cinema metaphor, but Story missions should get its own glyph.
Wheel and support legs directly represent the attraction.
Ticket glyph implies scheduled or ticketed activity; records include ruins, murals, memorials, buildings and an abandoned hovercraft. The source events tag alone does not establish playable events.

recommendation.action: Avoid ticketed/playable-event implication; preserve source events tag and uncertainty. Do not reclassify all event-tagged records as missions or Easter eggs without evidence.

categoryAudit.assessment: Airship silhouette fits the one blimp observation; Activities grouping must not imply it is controllable.
Plane is fine for the Dodo but is the wrong silhouette for the News helicopter record; add a record-level helicopter override without changing its vehicle group.

recommendation.action: Keep plane default, but implement explicit entry-news-heli → helicopter icon override. Do not change it to the Helicopter tours activity category.

categoryAudit.assessment: Boxy front and chrome/grille treatment provide a plausible classic-car glyph.
Car with adjustment/gear mark communicates a modified vehicle.
The current SVG is an ambulance with a medical cross; the sole record is a police SUV. Use a generic siren-equipped car with a police variant.

recommendation.action: Use neutral siren-equipped vehicle default; the current police SUV should not show a medical cross.

categoryAudit.assessment: Two wheels, handlebar and frame directly represent a motorcycle.
Raised boxy vehicle is an acceptable category symbol, but the Quad bike record benefits from a quad-specific silhouette.

recommendation.action: Keep offroad category default; use quad for entry-blazer so its silhouette matches its explicit title.

categoryAudit.assessment: The SVG is a closed box/delivery truck, while the record describes an open-bed Rancher pickup. Use an open-bed pickup glyph.

recommendation.action: Replace closed-box truck with an open-bed pickup.

categoryAudit.assessment: Side-profile car fits the sedan record.
Ship bow, deck and waves convey a vessel while the category retains scenery uncertainty.
Low front-view car is a suitable category-level sports-car glyph.
Sail and mast falsely suggest sailing for a kayak, airboat, powerboats and a personal watercraft. Use a neutral hull/waves glyph with record-specific variants if desired.

recommendation.action: Remove mast/sail default. Use hull/waves; optional entry-kayak → kayak override. Keep group Vehicles and its orange.

categoryAudit.assessment: Shirt matches clothing bundles.
Long-gun silhouette with stock, barrel and magazine matches the rifle class.
Backpack is a general equipment metaphor; no claim about actual bag functionality follows.
Pistol slide, grip and trigger guard fit handgun records.
Cylinder and barrel visually distinguish the revolver from the pistol.
Long barrel, stock and fore-end treatment fit a shotgun.
Palette is abstract customization, but its only map record is Sara’s Unisex Salon, which should be discoverable with Barbers rather than treated as a loose item.

categoryAudit.assessment: Parcel with check mark conveys delivery without inventing a specific contraband item.

categoryAudit.assessment: Face in scan brackets is a meaningful wanted-person symbol.

categoryWideIssues.issue: All 47 records derive from a broad events tag, yet the titles include static buildings, ruins, murals, memorials and scenery. A ticket icon and event label should not be read as a confirmed activity trigger.
categoryWideIssues.recommendation: Use Event-related locations as display label and a neutral event-location glyph. Retain every source tag and unconfirmed/demolished status. Reclassify individual records only with title/source support.

categoryWideIssues.issue: The leisure source bucket is broader than food/nightlife; music notes are unrepresentative of towers, sports grounds and pools.
categoryWideIssues.recommendation: Use Leisure venues for the remaining generic bucket and the existing specific sport, bar or cinema categories for explicit titles. Pool L1470 must not be automatically assigned the billiards Pool icon without a source establishing billiards.

categoryWideIssues.issue: Trees alone do not represent water and terrain records.
categoryWideIssues.recommendation: Use natural-landscape for the category. Use a water or terrain subtype icon only when the record title/tag explicitly supports it.

fallbackAudit.evidence: categories=Object.keys(MAP_CATEGORIES); enabledCategories=new Set(categories); filter() requires enabledCategories.has(r.category).
fallbackAudit.behavior: An unknown record category is excluded from list and markers before metaFor fallback can help. The fallback pink map-pin is not a complete unknown-category strategy.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Normalize unknown categories to Miscellaneous before indexing, or include encountered categories in the filter taxonomy with an explicit generic metadata record. Keep original source category as metadata. Add a development assertion for unknown keys.

fallbackAudit.behavior: Missing glyph definitions silently become a generic pin; most category icon names have no local fallback.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Validate every mapped glyph at build time; keep neutral runtime fallback but surface diagnostics in development. Do not substitute a different semantic glyph.

fallbackAudit.evidence: init() calls Object.keys(window.MAP_CATEGORIES) without a guard.
fallbackAudit.behavior: If map-types.js fails to load, optional metaFor access does not rescue initialization; catch reports a generic map-load failure.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Validate registry load before data initialization and provide an explicit retry/load message or compact default category registry.

fallbackAudit.behavior: Aircraft, Off-road, Watercraft and Weapons records cannot currently choose a more precise icon within the same canonical category.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Add a validated icon override keyed by explicit record/entry ID or optional record.icon. Whitelist against MAP_ICONS and fall back to category icon. Keep category/group/color unchanged. Apply the same resolver in list, marker and selected/related presentation; category legend remains the broad default.

fallbackAudit.evidence: At zoom >= 2, most categories use record ID bucket keys; only generic Landmarks continue clustering until zoom 3.
fallbackAudit.behavior: Seven exact-coordinate groups contain 15 records. Dossier/source markers or kayak/enduro/safehouse markers can overlay each other at high zoom. Search still exposes records, but the icon alone may hide the linked alternatives.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Keep a shared-location chooser/spiderfy behavior or show all coincident records in the selection card. Do not arbitrarily offset source coordinates or delete the source/dossier identities.

fallbackAudit.behavior: Runtime color loop overwrites initial tuple colors, then housing and hotel overrides run.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Treat effective colors as authoritative when implementing glyph changes; tests should assert them after executing the full source.

fallbackAudit.evidence: items includes Weapon shops; vehicles includes Fuel stations, customization, services, respray, washes, bicycle shops; services includes Services and Entertainment group records.
fallbackAudit.behavior: Helpful cross-layer services are intentional, but a too-broad leisure→Food & nightlife mapping makes sports structures appear in Shops & services. A marker in Weapons & gear is not necessarily a weapon pickup.
fallbackAudit.recommendation: Preserve the contextual facility inclusions and distinct category labels/glyphs. Resolve generic leisure record misclassifications, and retain zero-count/source evidence wording.

taxonomyRules: Keep storefront/service locations separate from loose item pickups. No record in Weapon shops is evidence of a free weapon spawn.
Keep police station, prison, airbase and emergency vehicle categories distinct; direct title-based classification is representativeness, not proof of enterability.
Keep natural features separate from agriculture; do not turn an unconfirmed agriculture tag on an RV park into a farm claim.
Keep aircraft/boats as Vehicles; airports/marinas as Transport; helicopter tours as Activities. A matching silhouette must not move a vehicle sighting into an activity category.
All mission and collectible categories currently have zero records. Do not manufacture entries to populate their icons. Empty placeholders are supported by the on-screen zero-count note.
Stunt jumps can live in Collectibles as checklist progress, but labels should avoid calling them physical collectibles.
Events tags do not establish missions, triggers, ticketed entertainment, Easter eggs or time windows.
Preserve original names, question marks, source tags, source links and unconfirmed/demolished flags when improving presentation categories.
Real-world comparison addresses alone are insufficient to recategorize the corresponding in-game place; e.g. L199 remains a review case rather than an automatic police-station assignment.
